title: cymbopogon versicolor
intro: Cymbopogon versicolor, commonly known as the Green Lemon Grass, is a type of flowering plant in the Poaceae family, native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cymbopogon versicolor include its anxiolytic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine and aromatherapy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include citral, geraniol, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and fragrance.
